resources.string: Make icons and your desktop your own, one step at a time.
Enable KeiHome in LSPosed and grant its host scopes. First activation also requires a device restart. You can continue now and finish later.
Choose artwork, preview the result, then generate and apply. Downloading or previewing does not apply a theme.
Adjust Dock materials, app names, and launch appearance. Open Desktop tools or gesture navigation settings when you need them.
Finish any pending steps later. Revisit this guide anytime in Settings.
Check host permissions and versions. A grant does not confirm loading.

First activation requires a system restart: enable the module, grant scopes, manually reboot, then unlock to the home screen and wait briefly. API 102 automatic hot reload updates only the Java part. Updates that include new .so native code also require a manual system restart.\n\nAfter reading the upgrade notes and returning to the main page, restart advice appears once per version. You can confirm after five seconds. Confirmation only acknowledges the advice; you restart the device manually.
Check the runtime status and diagnostic sheet on Status first, then choose the right log for the issue. Include your version, environment and reproduction steps.
Enable the module and manage its scopes
Manage previews, generated archive retention and direct navigation from Status to the active icon pack. Direct navigation is on by default.
Adjust what you need, then check each category’s status. Search bar material can follow Dock or be set independently.
